title: Impacts of Nutlin-3a and exercise on murine double minute 2–enriched glioma treatment
review_type: Independent bounded primary-source qualification; parent had already read this paper.

proposed_entry.route: MDM2/p53 pharmacology in tumor-associated physical performance
proposed_entry.disposition: Retain experimental tumor-associated function reserve; no current MVA lead.

identity.source_product: AbMole M2894, Nutlin-3a, as explicitly named in animal Methods.
identity.manufacturer_confirmation: Official AbMole MDM2 listing distinguishes M2894 Nutlin-3a (active enantiomer) from M2185 Nutlin-3 and M2895 Nutlin-3b. Its potency statement is manufacturer information, not a newly measured binding result from this paper.
identity.source_naming_limit: Paper sometimes shortens the name to Nutlin-3 and frames it as a natural product/nonpharmacological approach. Retain the explicit M2894 drug identity; do not infer dietary or natural-supplement status.
identity.availability_limit: Research-use listing is not patient medicine, current stock, clinical approval or a human dosing recommendation. Lot/purity and exact injection formulation were not independently verified.

model.animal: Five-week-old male BALB/c nude mice with intracranial U87MG-derived tumors, including an MDM2-overexpressing tumor arm. Authors label the model LGG. This does not establish equivalence to human lower-grade glioma or a normal-muscle model.
model.groups: Separate exercise-only sham/tumor-sedentary/tumor-exercise experiment and an MDM2-OE-related comparison containing NC/control, empty vector, untreated MDM2-OE, exercise+MDM2-OE, Nutlin-3a+MDM2-OE and standalone Nutlin-3a conditions. Not every panel displays every group.
allocation_limits: Methods generally states n=5–6/group; Figure6 behavior captions specify n=5. Exact allocation of all48 animals across the experiment sets is not reconstructable from the report.
A caption says four groups while enumerating six. Implantation dose/site descriptions differ within Methods.
Open-field Methods gives a four-versus-six count, unlike some figure captions; retain panel-specific reported n.
No Nutlin-treated normal/sham mouse group. Standalone Nutlin-3a label does not establish normal-mouse exposure.

treatment.animal_dose: 40 mg/kg intraperitoneal Nutlin-3a, starting day3 after tumor implantation; saline control stated.
treatment.animal_schedule_limit: Frequency, total administrations, stop date and drug solvent/preparation are not clearly specified. The18-day exercise regimen is not automatically the drug duration.
treatment.exercise: Separate intervention; called voluntary, but Methods also describes acclimation and progressive motorized treadmill training.
treatment.cell_exposure: U87MG viability/pathway panels use2,4,8µM;8µM shown for immunofluorescence. A48-hour treatment is explicit for the apoptosis flow experiment, not safely transferable to every assay.
treatment.combination_limit: No defined Nutlin-3a+exercise arm. Prose mentioning combination does not demonstrate combination efficacy, additivity or synergy.

measured_function.result: Higher distance and velocity with reported significant pairwise comparisons; n=5 per caption.
measured_function.limit: Whole-animal movement in a brain-tumor model, not isolated muscle contractility or a measured MVA response.

measured_function.result: Less deterioration in baseline-relative grip scores at days6,12,21.

day_specific.drug_comparison: Significant printed comparison; exact small-font value not transcribed.

measured_function.measurement_unit: Forelimb maximal grip force measured three trials/mouse/day, averaged, then normalized to baseline. Plot displays negative baseline-relative percentages; no absolute-force reconstruction or normal-muscle restoration claim.

measured_function.result: Qualitative trajectory images accompany a favorable narrative.
measured_function.limit: No quantitative latency/probe-trial summary or inferential statistic in this panel; do not rank this alongside the quantified grip/open-field outcomes.

positives: Dose-associated reduction in U87MG CCK-8 signal and increased Annexin V/PI apoptosis following actual Nutlin-3a treatment.
Caspase/p53/p21 protein or transcript responses and lower ROS in selected drug conditions are consistent with pathway activity.
MDM2 overexpression and attenuation of selected Nutlin responses provide model context; ligand docking/MD is computational, not measured target occupancy.
nulls_and_limits: Figure6B p53 mRNA is not significant at the shown doses;8µM givesP=.086. Protein-associated pathway effects therefore should not be described as uniformly confirmed transcript induction.

Caspase3 at2µM is nonsignificant (P=.171); higher-dose increases occur. AdditionalFigure7 protein plots provide abundance estimates, not independent biological replication or a measured caspase-cleavage activity assay.
Some caspase blots are procaspase9/full-length species; actual flow cytometry supplies separate apoptosis evidence.
Migration/invasion and clinical-prognosis claims exceed these viability, apoptosis, marker and computational endpoints; no direct migration/invasion result is assigned here.

figure6J_check.consequence: No false graph/prose contradiction from relabeling green as MDM2-OE. J cannot by itself establish the within-OE basal-to-treated response. Molecular comparator limits do not erase the separate OE-controlled behavioral positives.

not_measured: Serial tumor regression or tumor-burden response
Normal-mouse drug functional benefit or normal-tissue selectivity
BUB1B/BUBR1 drug-response abundance, localization or function
Chromosome segregation, aneuploidy, checkpoint rescue or renewable progenitor output
BUB1B_scope: BUB1B is among17 genes identified through computational essentiality/risk-group differential-expression/network analyses. It is not one of the drug-response PCR/protein endpoints. No Nutlin-mediated BUBR1 restoration can be inferred from the co-mention.

statistics_and_reproducibility.authors_report: At least three experiments, mean±SD, one-way ANOVA with Bonferroni post hoc and Mann–Whitney for nonnormal data; Figure6 specifies ANOVA/Bonferroni.
statistics_and_reproducibility.limits: Biological preparations versus technical cell wells are not resolved for every n. Three within-animal grip pulls are not three animals. Repeated-day dependence/global multiplicity, blinding and raw behavioral data are not adequately described for independent reproduction. Printed P values are author-reported, not recalculated.
statistics_and_reproducibility.data_availability: Public GEO data underpin computational work; other study data available from corresponding author. No contact or raw-data acquisition performed.

competitive_decision: The actual drug-associated grip and locomotor improvements are substantive functional positives, not marker-only evidence. Retain a tumor-associated function reserve. The tested defect is MDM2-enriched glioma-associated impairment, whereas a corresponding remediable MDM2/p53 defect in BUB1B/MVA was not measured. Neither source shows normal-muscle/progenitor/fidelity preservation. This does not displace provisional niacin restoration or apitegromab compensation, which also remain unproven in MVA. Do not infer patient benefit or harm from the tumor mechanism alone.
source_status: Today’s saved authoritative PubMed record lists Journal Article without indexed CommentsCorrections; PMC11438351.1 has no related-article notice. Bounded fresh search identified no matching formal correction/retraction; not an integrity clearance.
